name: Weather-and-Air-Pollution-Kiev
description: Hourly data, representing weather and air pollution parameters for Kiev, Ukraine. The dataset covers the period from November 25, 2020 to October 05, 2024. The cyclical parameters were generated by the author. The weather and air pollution data were sourced from [OpenWeatherMap.org](https://openweathermap.org/).
creator: Dmitry Zhora
